_comment: ds-measure spec (@micro/ds S3). Staged per unit (builder decision, REPORT 2026-11-23): each unit adds its own checks here — the S2 seed ids return with their components (amount-visibility-toggle: unit 2, status-badge-height: unit 3, icon-button: S4 IconButton). Expectations reference docs/design-system/tokens.json by dotted path, or a fixed px number.

checks._note: Rule 72/ج1: every segment centers its label horizontally AND vertically (of:parent — each label against its own segment box); icon-prefixed segments center the GROUP, which the label+icon flex row already does.
ActionBar min height = primary button 52 (size.button) + 2x12 block padding. The 24 padding is space.12 (no layout token; documented S7 value with the brief's 9.2 'safe area' text on top).
rule 4-7 shared row anatomy; the label-only sample sits at row-plain
the switch row rides the shared control-row anatomy
the search pill is size.search high (q1, ADDENDUM §1.1)

root = label 20 (type.label.line) + gap 8 (layout.label-to-field) + input 60: min size.field 56 (q1, §1.2-2) with the 1-row content taller — padding-block 2x16 + body line 26 + hairline borders 2 = 60 (the 16 padding keeps the first line aligned with TextField, §1.2-2)

1.7 t2 stack exact (the withSparkline sample carries the marker): padding 2x20 + label line 20 + 8 + value 48 + 8 + one line 20 + 16 + sparkline hero-sparkline-height 32 = 192 - the addendum's own estimate. The one line is CENTER-aligned (a baseline row would synthesize the diff's baseline from its icon svg and grow 3px) and the source's underline rides an out-of-flow ::after, so the line is a deterministic 20 on both engines, both views, and however the app wraps its icon node. The sparkline rides the content's full width (svg width 100%).

views._comment: Per-view specs (G2, owner request: every gate on BOTH views). The demo-compose view carries no catalog specimens, so it declares its own entries: only REAL elements of the compose page (marked on the page itself), same missing-element-is-a-fail discipline — a check that finds nothing proves nothing, on every view.
